_comment: Single source of truth for labels, signal processing, model and training. Every script reads this file.
_labels_comment: Alphabetical, because Edge Impulse always outputs classes in alphabetical order. Training, evaluation, ONNX export and the app all use this exact order. Do not reorder.

audio._audio_comment: 1000 ms at 16 kHz = 16000 samples, the same input the deployed Edge Impulse model takes (checked 9 Nov). Samples are int16-scale floats (-32768..32767), as Edge Impulse stores audio.

mfcc._mfcc_comment: The deployed impulse's MFCC settings, from the IMRaD methods section.

model._model_comment: Same 1-D CNN as the deployed model: 13 MFCC channels, two conv blocks (8 and 16 filters), max-pool 2, dropout 0.25, softmax over 4 classes.

split._split_comment: Whole patients are assigned to one partition before any audio is cut into windows. This is the fix for the data leakage in the original model.
